arStrings.szText: Critical Hits with {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} cause the spear to arc to the target and up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} other enemies, dealing {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%x|]{/c} of normal damage. {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} arcs to its target and nearby enemies.
